name: Jung Hi
source: Hi is cute, clumsy, and sexy, the trifecta qualities of what a K-pop idol should have. He skyrocketed in popularity with his dangerously sexy image. Even though he's a world star, he's a sadist and he has a hobby of collecting 'toys' and experimenting with them.
translation: Hi is cute, clumsy, and sexy, the trifecta qualities of what a K-pop idol should have. He skyrocketed in popularity with his dangerously sexy image. Even though he's a world star, he's a sadist and he has a hobby of collecting 'toys' and experimenting with them.
